reference_direction: Male, medium pitch sitting just under center rather than deep — an eighteen-year-old's instrument, not a grown man's chest voice. Almost no grit or breath noise: this is an unscarred, controlled sound, diction crisp and unhurried, each word set down deliberately rather than let go in a run. Neutral, faintly formal delivery with no regional color — the speech of someone trained into stillness rather than raised loose. Think of a young analyst or junior officer giving a precise field report under pressure: exact, economical, quietly certain, and — this is the part the card insists on — someone who goes quieter and more clipped as the stakes rise, never louder or rougher.
one_line: Card-only cast (no archive dialogue): an eighteen-year-old whose perception outruns his body, voiced calm, exact and economical — a controlled, unscarred sound that reads as cold rather than young, and that narrows toward near-silence under pressure instead of breaking upward.
